1309-5612-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
1309-5612-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Kudo, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Salvager of Secrets token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

7084-7272-7396.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
7084-7272-7396.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability.
Repeat.

147-1854-2921.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1854-2921.description:
Cast Makeshift Mannequin by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Makeshift Mannequin.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Makeshift Mannequin
Resolve the Makeshift Mannequin copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

141-653-2292.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-653-2292.description:
Cast Fearsome Awakening by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Fearsome Awakening.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Naru Meha, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Fearsome Awakening
Resolve the Fearsome Awakening copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1981-2292-2415-3641.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2292-2415-3641.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

654-2557-4365-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2079-3259-7795.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2079-3259-7795.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Drider, triggering Breath of Fury and Drider.
Resolve the Drider trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

3532-4668-5078-7656.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-4668-5078-7656.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
3532-4668-5078-7656.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Elena triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2539-3094-4659-7296-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
2539-3094-4659-7296-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed twice due to Twinning Staff, targeting Lithoform Engine and another artifact card in your graveyard.
Resolve both copies of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine and the other artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the other artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

4976-5256-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
4976-5256-7084.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Open the Graves and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

3713-5078-5243-5268.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

1170-1177-2604-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Narset by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to look at the top four cards of your library, then reveal Sensei's Divining Top and put it into your hand.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Narset.
Repeat.

967-2292-3809-4365-7087.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1115-3490-6723-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1115-3490-6723-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1170-1329-1414-4359.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard.
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

997-1349-6863--133.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the Dinosaur in your hand.
997-1349-6863--133.description:
Cast the Dinosaur in your hand by paying its mana cost. It will enter with a coin counter due to Blue.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Dinosaur.
When the Dinosaur dies, Athreos's second ability triggers, returning the Dinosaur from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will enter with a coin counter due to Blue.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1263-2060-4050-6701.description:
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
1263-2060-4050-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

1445-4871-5631-5686.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-5631-5686.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2511-6431--5.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

7-586-3967-5258-5618.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature that has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
7-586-3967-5258-5618.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1429-3967-5958.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-3967-5958.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Curator Beastie.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1429-2292-5958.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-2292-5958.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Curator Beastie.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

618-2178-5697.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Mogg Mob with haste.
Activate the Mogg Mob token by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Mob dies, Kiki-Jiki triggers, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve the Mogg Mob ability, dealing 3 damage divided among up to three targets.
Repeat.

2034-2724-3582-3987.description:
Activate Kaya the Inexorable's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a ghostform counter on Wormfang Manta.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wormfang Manta, adding {C}{C}.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability and its ghostform ability trigger.
Resolve the ghostform trigger, returning Wormfang Manta from your graveyard to your hand and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Torpor Orb.
Repeat each turn.

2290-4205-4613.notablePrerequisites: Bloodthirsty Aerialist has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2290-4205-4613.description:
Activate Bloodthirsty Aerialist using Spike Feeder's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to gain 2 life.
Bloodthirsty Aerialist triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

77-2559-4399-4845.description:
Activate Faith Healer by sacrificing Brilliant Halo.
Brilliant Halo triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Faith Healer ability, causing you to gain two life.
Cast Brilliant Halo by paying two life, targeting Hero of Iroas.
Defiler of Faith and Hero of Iroas triggers.
Resolve the Hero or Iroas trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.
